valueCreationTemplate: You may create value most naturally by {talentVerb}, {roleVerb}, and {impactPhrase}.

alignmentMessages.talent_capability_aligned: Aligned: how you see yourself matches your natural talent pattern.
alignmentMessages.talent_capability_divergent: Worth exploring: the strengths you chose differ from your natural talent pattern. You may be relying on learned skills more than natural ones.
alignmentMessages.economic_role_aligned: Aligned: the areas you want to create value in suit the role you naturally play.
alignmentMessages.economic_gap_role: Worth exploring: you're drawn to areas that rely on your least natural role. Consider partnering with someone strong where you are not.

reflectionPrompts: Does your current environment let you use your strongest talents and your natural role?
Who in your life plays your “gap” role, and how could you work with them more deliberately?
Which part of your work gives you the most energy, and how much of your week does it take up?
disclaimer: This is a reflective self-discovery tool, not a psychological or career assessment.
